description.narrative: This is a core contribution agreement with Interpeace. The purpose is to contribute to Interpeace work with equipping communities to better manage conflicts in a non-violent manner and obtain the support by an international system that is more peace responsive and effective in contributing to peace and stability across the HDP nexus. The contribution runs from 2022-2024.

title.narrative: Global peace efforts are enhanced through a greater and operationalized focus on resilience for peace and innovative financing mechanisms for peacebuilding.
A resilience barometer and peace bonds are developed, piloted and rolled-out.

target.value: Learning from the implementation of the Trust, Resilience, and Inclusion Barometer in Ethiopia is disseminated across Interpeace and with other relevant stakeholders, and a dedicated workstream on innovative financing is developed within Interpeace.

actual.value: 12 countries have participated in programmes in which resilience for peace was enhanced. The Total number of people engaged was 70 863 of which 34% were women and 25% were young people.

target.value: The Barometer is implemented in Ethiopia, and a mapping of initiatives in the area of innovative financing for peace is conduced and synergies are sought.

actual.value: Ethiopias security situation has continued to have significant social impacts, with millions of citizens displaced, thousands killed, and economic challenges growing. The current circumstances are threatening the prospects of sustainable peace and democratic gains. In this context, the pilot Ethiopian Peace Index was launched in June 2023 in partnership with Ministry of Peace of the Federal Republic of Ethiopia, ABCON Research & Consulting and the Centre for Sustainable Peace and Democratic Development. The research was Interpeace's first attempt, since the adoption of the 2021- 2025 strategy, to advance a trust, resilience and inclusion barometer. The Ethiopian Peace Index is a flexible tool which provides a quantitative evidence base that can (and should) be revisited and re-analysed as new needs and research questions arise. target.value: The methodology for a Trust, Resilience, and Inclusion Barometer has been developed and a feasibility study on peace bonds has been conducted.

title.narrative: Communities in countries/regions supported by Interpeace peacebuilding are better equipped to manage conflicts in a non-violent manner and are supported by an international system that is more peace responsive and effective in contributing to peace and stability across the HDP nexus.
Local infrastructures for peace are enhanced and actors within the multilateral system are responsive to their capacities, needs, and realities.

target.value: Interpeace and partners will support at least 170 local infrastructures for peace in at least twelve countries, which will lead to at least 1,000 local initiatives contributing to the transformation of 200 local conflicts.

actual.value: Contributions to 163 infrastructures have been made.
